summary: Iteration 179 - Full testing of Admin login, Admin Revenue Dashboard, Coach login, ProSpace guide popup, and backend assigned-exercise/meal-detail endpoints. All features working correctly.

admin_login.details: Admin login via email (admin@chutex.fr / admin123) works correctly. Login form detects email (contains @) and sends as-is without phone prefix.

admin_revenue_dashboard.details: Revenue tab shows all expected data: Total HT (450 EUR), Monthly HT (180 EUR), 4 KPI cards, revenue chart (6 months), top pros list (Coach Alain Pro - 450 EUR), payments table with 10 entries.

coach_login.details: Coach login via phone (0655443322 / test123) works correctly. Phone starting with 0 is converted to +33 prefix. User lands on Guardian Home showing beneficiaries and revenue stats.

prospace_guide_popup.details: Guide popup opens when clicking ? button in ProSpace header. Shows full-screen blur overlay (backdropFilter: blur(32px), background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55), position: fixed) with 7 glass-styled cards explaining features.

backend_assigned_exercise_detail.details: GET /api/pro/assigned-exercise-detail/{id} correctly merges template data (video_url, image, steps, description, icon, equipment, muscle_group, difficulty, category) from exercise template.

backend_assigned_meal_detail.details: GET /api/pro/assigned-meal-detail/{id} correctly merges template data (image, ingredients, steps, calories, proteins, glucides, lipides, notes, items) from meal template.

api_tests.POST /api/auth/login (admin): 200 OK - Returns token and admin user
api_tests.POST /api/auth/login (coach): 200 OK - Returns token and guardian user with professional_type: coach
api_tests.GET /api/backoffice/revenue: 200 OK - Returns revenue data with total_revenue_ht, monthly_revenue_ht, revenue_by_month, top_pros, recent_payments
api_tests.GET /api/pro/assigned-exercises/{ben_id}: 200 OK - Returns list of assigned exercises
api_tests.GET /api/pro/assigned-meals/{ben_id}: 200 OK - Returns list of assigned meals
api_tests.GET /api/pro/assigned-exercise-detail/{i: 200 OK - Returns exercise with merged template data
api_tests.GET /api/pro/assigned-meal-detail/{id}: 200 OK - Returns meal with merged template data

context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working correctly. Admin login detects email by checking for @ symbol. Coach login converts phone starting with 0 to +33 prefix. ProSpace guide popup has full-screen blur overlay with glass cards. Backend detail endpoints merge template data correctly. To bypass onboarding, set localStorage('chutex_onboarding_done', '1').
